body.x: Exo Systems will show exoRehab at CES 2019,the world's largest technology exhibition in Las Vegas, USA, from January 8(Tue) to January 11 (Fri), 2019.

Founded in January 2017, Exo Systems aimsto complement, assist, and even strengthen the physical limits of the humanbody through the convergence of robotics and artificial intelligencetechnologies. In today's society, the vast majority of patients and the elderlyare constrained by the impairment and decline of physical abilities. However,there is still a solution to this problem. Exo Systems will present itssolution through exoRehab, a rehabilitation solution that combines roboticswith artificial intelligence technology.

The exoRehab provides various functionssuch as joint rehabilitation exercise, electrical stimulation therapy, EMGsignal measurement, etc., in comparison with the existing equipment used forrehabilitation of the musculoskeletal rehabilitation site, and has moreconvenient usability.
